physical.description: Lean, angular build. Strong jawline. As a teen: tall and wiry, blonde/light hair, clean-cut farm-kid look. By his 40s: shaved/bald head, lean and fit, light stubble, olive-toned skin from Florida sun. Big, wide smile — the kind that takes over his whole face. Favors black t-shirts, backwards caps, chunky glasses. High energy in how he carries himself — leans into photos, leans into conversations. In the graduation photo (late '90s) he's rail-thin in blue cap and gown, towering slightly over Beth. On a boat as a teen: bleached blonde hair, shirtless, lean but not yet filled out. Current era: clean lines, minimal — the black shirt and shaved head read as deliberate, like a man who stopped caring about vanity and started caring about velocity.

self_harm.detail: Cut himself in high school. Heaviest at age 15-16. Scars on arm AND stomach. Started cutting near other scars to hide it. Multiple drivers braided together: (1) controlling pain on his terms, (2) 'life force spilling out,' (3) knowing it would hurt his parents if they saw it — a message, not just an act, (4) anger at the world and everything around him. Trigger context: CJ had gone to a different school, so Shawn was isolated; he was facing the realization he was NOT going to be a wrestler and that the accident would impact him long-term. It stopped when peer reaction outweighed the relief — 'too much flak from people around me that wasn't worth the value I was getting from it.'

emotional_wall.detail: Couldn't feel intensity of holding Gia for first time. 'Spent so much time in rational head, not emotional brain.'

management_philosophy.detail: Took the playbook from Elon Musk at Quorum: leave meetings that waste your time, call people out who aren't contributing, chew through ineffective resources, jump in and do the work yourself when others can't deliver. Anchor story: one Quorum engineer spent 300 hours on a data-import project Shawn had estimated at 30 (being generous) — Shawn came in and did most of it in 8. Went through 'more than a dozen' Quorum resources — some they thought were top resources — and 'chewed them up and spit them out.' Three-stage arc of self-reflection on this era: regret (Session 5d) → softening (Session 6, 'should have been more collaborative') → vindication (2026-05-13, 'AI now proves the playbook was right; the environment was wrong'). EnergiAcres / Terrasow is the org being built on the Read-2 playbook: AI strips the bullshit so engineers can show what they actually do.

beliefs.label: atheist with a metaphysics
beliefs.detail: Atheist. Studied a multitude of religions and philosophies 'to understand how human thought and progression made and why they tried to fill certain aspects of life with God and religion — and what it was used for then, and what it's used for now.' Where it landed: collective consciousness exists. Could be in a simulation right now. But when it's over, it's over. 'Enjoy the most that you can right now because it might be all that you get. That's actually what's beautiful about life is that it happens and then it's gone. Really make the most of it.' Atheist, but not the angry kind — the appreciative kind. Finite life as the source of meaning, not its absence.

physical.description:
Built thick — stocky, broad shoulders, barrel chest, thick forearms, hairy chest. Approximately 5'10"–5'11" (Session 6 confirmation). Dark brown hair throughout life — long and shaggy in his teens (high-school graduation photo: shoulder-length brown hair, big smile, no mustache yet, cap and gown on a football field, ~1974), still long for his wedding to Beth (white tuxedo with black satin lapels, ruffled shirt, black bowtie, pink boutonniere, thin mustache just coming in). After that, the hair gets cut short and lives under a ball cap for the rest of his life — he was ashamed of going bald and hid it under the hat (Shawn trained himself to own it instead). The signature feature is the thick dark mustache, going gray by his late forties. Greenish-hazel eyes that stuck out — the eyes Shawn inherited. Strong jaw, prominent brow, thick neck. Tanned and weathered from oilfield work and, later, Florida sun. Big thick hands.

Uniform: a ball cap (the iconic pink 'Cutter Oil Co.' cap with the pump-jack logo, or the black Cutter Oil cap, or the yellow Cutter Oil cap, or a generic red cap — almost never without one). White cotton t-shirt or sleeveless cutoff, Marlboros in the breast pocket. Gold chain visible at the collar (sometimes with a pendant). Sunglasses hung off the neckline of a tank top. Jeans and work boots. Carhartt in winter.

PHOTO INVENTORY (10 on-disk + 3 chat-shared awaiting upload):
• scan (114).jpg — High school graduation (~1974, age 18): long shoulder-length brown hair, big smile, no mustache yet. The Chuck before he became Chuck.
• scan (113).jpg — Wedding to Beth (late 1970s): white tuxedo with black satin lapels, ruffled white shirt, black bowtie, pink boutonniere, shoulder-length hair, thin mustache just appearing. Beth in full white lace gown and veil. They look incredibly young.

Holding a stack of EASTERN well-logging booklets ('Gamma Ray • Neutron • Caliper • Compensated Density • Resistivity'). Shawn (age 17, white tee) loading the truck bed in the background. Father and son working together. Same week as the excavator photo of Shawn.
• scan (90).jpg — On the farm: yellow Cutter Oil cap, blue plaid flannel, standing with a black Angus calf among Holsteins, white barn behind. The working-farm Chuck.
• scan (171).jpg — Close-up with a curly-haired blonde woman (era: late 90s / early 2000s, ID TBD): pink 'Cutter Oil Co.' cap, white tank top, gold chain, mustache flecked with gray. Indoor setting, mounted fish on the wall.
• IMG (2).jpg and IMG_0001.jpg — On a boat in Florida: straw cowboy hat with band, sunglasses, shirtless, gold chain with pendant, phone to ear (always working, always on a call). Pink-trimmed white speedboat. King of his domain.
• IMG_0058.JPG — Holding baby Gia, May 2010: black Cutter Oil cap, white polo, Marlboros in the breast pocket, mustache fully gray. Looking DOWN at her with an expression that breaks the whole tough-guy frame. Six months before he died. THIS is the softening Shawn described.

CHAT-SHARED PHOTOS (need upload to disk):
• OFFICE / shirtless: standing in the home office, light-blue walls. Behind him: the BLACK LEATHER CHAIR (the chair where he sat overlooking the property — confirmed Session 6) and a wooden oil-derrick model on the desk. Multicolored cap with antlers (deer hunting?). Hairy chest, jeans, looking down at his hands (likely rolling a cigarette). This photo VISUALLY CONFIRMS the office scene Shawn described.
• ELEVATOR / cigarette: Florida elevator (Florida Certificate of Operation visible on the wall), white tank top, gold chain, pink cap, sunglasses at chest. Cigarette in mouth directly under a 'NO SMOKING / NO FUMAR' sign — and he's POSING for it. Peak jokester.

ARC OF THE FACE: long-haired smiling kid in '74 → long-haired groom with the first mustache in the late 70s → mustachioed working man through the 80s and 90s, hat-and-Marlboros, oilfield and barn → softening grandfather holding Gia in 2010. Six months later, gone.

silent_treatment.detail: Conditional, not blanket. The silence specifically when you asked for approval. Shawn (2026-05-13) acknowledges he sees the same operating system surfacing in himself when tired of arguing with kids and wife: 'It's just easier to shut down. So in that sense, I kind of get where he was coming from.'

eulogy_partial.detail: Shawn gave a eulogy at 31. The gist of his close (per 2026-05-13 memo): 'Work could come later — it wasn't just about work.'
